plugin.name: Commerce USDT
plugin.description: USDT (ERC-20) crypto payment gateway for GoPress Commerce. Pull-based confirmation: a per-order HD-derived deposit address is watched on-chain and settled idempotently once confirmed. EVM-abstracted (Ethereum first; BSC/Polygon ready). Opt-in satellite that depends only on the Core Commerce contracts.
plugin.settings.title: %s - Plugin Settings
plugin.usdt.settings.payment_help: When enabled and fully configured, USDT appears among the checkout payment methods.
plugin.usdt.settings.rpc_help: A read-only JSON-RPC endpoint (self-hosted or a trusted provider). Used only to query blocks and transfer events.
plugin.usdt.settings.contract_help: Leave blank to use the selected chain's default mainnet USDT contract; on a testnet, provide your test token contract.
plugin.usdt.settings.xpub_help: A watch-only xpub (e.g. m/44'/60'/0'/0) used to derive a unique deposit address per order. The server holds only the public key and has no spend authority.
plugin.usdt.settings.confirmations_help: Blocks required before a payment is considered settled (24 recommended on Ethereum mainnet).
plugin.usdt.settings.rate_help: The rate converting the order total (USD) into the USDT amount due. Default 1.00.
plugin.usdt.settings.ready: Configuration complete. USDT will appear at checkout.
plugin.usdt.settings.not_ready: Enable USDT and provide the RPC URL, contract address, and receiving xpub before it can appear at checkout.
